value.title: Daredevil S2#6
value.text: District Attorney Samantha Reyes tries to make Matt and Foggy drop Frank Castle's case, and when Castle pleads not guilty she sets out to prosecute him.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The DA who tries to make Matt drop Frank Castle's case.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A lawyer Reyes tries to push off Frank Castle's case.

split.title: Daredevil S2#7
split.text: Reyes prosecutes Frank Castle at his trial, with Matt and Foggy defending him.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The DA who prosecutes Frank Castle against Matt.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Frank Castle's defense lawyer, facing Reyes in court.

verdicts.why: Reyes first confronts Matt and tells him to drop Castle's case in S2#6 (Regrets Only); the trial itself runs from S2#7, so that part is split off. Her hidden role in the massacre only comes out in S2#10 and is left out of the earlier stages.
Fandom confirms the order: in S3#16 May beats Giyera hand to hand and he is taken aboard Zephyr One, then he escapes, hijacks the plane and lands it at Schoonebeek, leaving May badly wounded.
Fandom's S2 account of Mike shows no moment of May keeping her distance; that happened in S1#10 when he first joined the Bus.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#15
value.text: Melinda May secretly reports to Nick Fury on a private line about how Phil Coulson is recovering from his resurrection.
value.on_a_card_about_b: May's boss, who secretly has her report on Coulson's recovery.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Fury's agent, who secretly reports to him on Coulson.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#17
split.text: May admits that Nick Fury brought her back to build Coulson's team and report on his recovery, and Coulson stops trusting her for a time.
split.on_a_card_about_b: May's boss, who had her build Coulson's team and watch him.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Fury's agent, who built Coulson's team and reported on him until Coulson found out.

verdicts.why: May's call to Fury ('Coulson knows') is in S1#15, but the line is found in S1#16 and she admits in S1#17 that it goes to Fury and that she assembled the team, so Coulson's loss of trust is split to S1#17.

value.title: Daredevil S1#1
value.text: Turk Barrett is a small-time crook trafficking women for Fisk's organization, and the masked Matt beats him and frees the women.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A small-time crook Matt beats while freeing the women he is trafficking.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The masked man who beats Turk and frees the women he is trafficking.

split.title: Daredevil S1#11
split.text: Turk Barrett is a small-time arms dealer whom Daredevil roughs up for information again and again.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A small-time arms dealer Matt roughs up for information again and again.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Roughs Turk up for information again and again as Daredevil.

verdicts.why: The masked Matt first beats Turk at the docks in S1#1, but that is a rescue, not a shakedown; the first time he roughs Turk up for information (Melvin Potter's name) is S1#11, so the information part is split there.
Tuklo's story and Maya's visions of her are in Echo episode 3, 'Tuklo' (EC103); episode 4 is 'Taloa'.

value.title: Echo#2
value.text: Skully, an old friend of Maya's family who runs a pawn shop in Tamaha, welcomes her home and patches up her broken prosthetic leg. He also tells her about Chafa, the first Choctaw, from whom her family's power descends.
value.on_a_card_about_b: An old family friend who patches Maya's broken prosthetic leg.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A family friend home in Tamaha, whose broken leg Skully patches up.

split.title: Echo#3
split.text: Skully brings Maya the new prosthetic leg he has built for her and urges her to go see her grandmother.
split.on_a_card_about_b: An old family friend who builds Maya a new prosthetic leg.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A family friend for whom Skully builds a new prosthetic leg.

verdicts.why: In episode 2 (Lowak) Skully welcomes Maya back, only patches her old leg as a temporary fix and tells her about Chafa; the new leg is delivered in episode 3 (Tuklo), so that part is split.

value.text: Mariah Dillard is Tilda Johnson's mother, but Mama Mabel had Tilda taken from her, and Mamie Johnson raised her. Tilda poisons Mariah in prison.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Mariah's daughter, raised apart from her, who poisons her in prison.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Tilda's mother, who was kept from raising her. Tilda poisons her in prison.

verdicts.why: Fandom says Tilda was taken from Mariah by Mama Mabel's decision and largely raised by Mamie Johnson, but it also says Mariah left her when she was eight, so 'as a baby' and 'never raised her' go too far and are cut.
Raina first appears in S1#5 (Girl in the Flower Dress), abducting Chan Ho Yin in Hong Kong while the team raids the Centipede base there; S1#11 is only her capture. The text is anchored to Hong Kong.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#15
value.text: When Robert Gonzales' S.H.I.E.L.D. takes over the Playground, May slips past his agents, storms his office, and shoots him with an I.C.E.R.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A rival director May shoots with an I.C.E.R.
value.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who shoots Gonzales with an I.C.E.R.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#17
split.text: May takes the seat Gonzales offered her on his council as Coulson's advocate, to help bring the two sides of S.H.I.E.L.D. together.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A rival director whose council May joins.
split.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who joins Gonzales' council as Coulson's advocate.

verdicts.why: The I.C.E.R. shot is in S2#15 (One Door Closes), which leaves them as enemies; Gonzales offers the seat in S2#16 and May is serving on his board in S2#17 (Melinda), so the alliance is split.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#11
value.text: Ruby Hale, General Hale's daughter and Hydra's young enforcer, ambushes May and the team with androids at an aerospace facility.
value.on_a_card_about_b: General Hale's daughter, Hydra's young enforcer. Ambushes May's team.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#18
split.text: May is there when Ruby takes in the gravitonium and loses control of its power.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Hydra's young enforcer, who takes in the gravitonium as May watches.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who is there when Ruby takes in the gravitonium.

verdicts.why: The St. Louis aerospace ambush (with May present) is S5#11, but Ruby takes in the gravitonium with May present in S5#18, so that part is split.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#2
value.text: Sinara, Kasius's Kree enforcer in the Lighthouse, takes Simmons away while May is helping her.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Kasius's Kree enforcer, who takes Simmons away from May.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent from whom Sinara takes Simmons.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#4
split.text: May fights Sinara with a Kree battle ax on a bad leg and loses, and Sinara hands her to Kasius for his arena.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Kasius's Kree enforcer. Beats May and hands her over for the arena.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent Sinara defeats and hands over to Kasius.

verdicts.why: Sinara takes Simmons after May helps treat Reese in S5#2; the Level 35 fight and handover to Kasius are S5#4 (A Life Earned), so they are split.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#4
value.text: Sunil Bakshi, disguised as Glenn Talbot, lures May into his hotel room, ties her up, and threatens to torture her for S.H.I.E.L.D.'s secrets. She breaks free and attacks him.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#11
split.text: May and Coulson hand their prisoner Bakshi over to the real Glenn Talbot.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A Hydra prisoner May and Coulson hand over to Talbot.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who hands Bakshi over to Talbot.

verdicts.why: The hotel-room capture and threat of torture are in S2#4 (Face My Enemy); the handover to Talbot is in S2#11 (Aftershocks), so it is split.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#11
value.text: Victoria Hand takes command of the Bus while Coulson is missing, and May backs her decision to put Skye off the plane.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A commander who takes over the Bus while Coulson is missing.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's pilot, who backs Hand's call to put Skye off the plane.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#17
split.text: During the Hydra Uprising, Hand reroutes the Bus to the Hub, unsure whose side May and the team are on.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A commander who doubts May's loyalty during the Hydra Uprising.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's pilot, whose loyalty Hand doubts.

verdicts.why: Hand's command of the Bus and Skye's removal are S1#11 (The Magical Place); her suspicion of Coulson's team during the Hydra Uprising is S1#16-17, so it is split. Fandom says she reroutes the Bus rather than boarding it.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#10
value.text: Edison Po works on the Clairvoyant's Centipede project, which used Mike Peterson as a test subject, and helps kidnap Mike's son Ace to trap Coulson.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A Centipede operative who helps kidnap Mike's son.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A former Centipede test subject whose son Po helps kidnap.

verdicts.why: Po is freed and sets the trap with Ace in S1#10 and dies in S1#11, so the move is right, but 'Garrett's' project would spoil the S1#17 reveal. Po is a tactician, not a scientist, and no source has him experimenting on Mike.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#16
value.text: Controlled by Centipede, Deathlok ambushes Felix Blake during the hunt for the Clairvoyant and leaves him critically injured. When Blake begs him to remember his son Ace, Deathlok answers that Mike Peterson is dead.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent Mike cripples while under Centipede's control.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Cripples Blake under Centipede's control and says Mike Peterson is dead.

verdicts.why: The attack and 'Mike Peterson's dead' line are in S1#16 (End of the Beginning), but Hydra is not revealed until S1#17 and the broken spine is only stated in S3#14, so those words are changed for the earlier title.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#16
value.text: Centipede rebuilds Mike as the cyborg Deathlok, and the Clairvoyant turns him against Coulson's team.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The agent whose team Mike is turned against.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A man rebuilt as Deathlok and turned against Coulson's team.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#20
split.text: Now working openly for Hydra, Deathlok tries to stop Coulson escaping the Bus with Skye and fires a missile at them.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The agent Mike, as Hydra's Deathlok, tries to stop.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Hydra's cyborg, who fires on Coulson as he escapes with Skye.

verdicts.why: Nothing with Deathlok happens in S1#18; he first attacks Coulson's team in S1#16 (firing at May), but Hydra is only revealed in S1#17, so the Hydra part is split to S1#20 (Nothing Personal), where Deathlok fires on Coulson and Skye.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#10
value.text: Raina recruited Mike Peterson into Centipede with a promise to put him back to work after his injury. When he turns on Centipede, she kidnaps his son Ace and trades the boy for Coulson.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The recruiter who brought Mike into Centipede, then kidnaps his son.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A Centipede recruit whose son Raina kidnaps to get to Coulson.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#11
split.text: After the bridge explosion, Raina oversees Mike's recovery as Centipede takes control of him.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The Centipede recruiter who oversees Mike's recovery after the bridge blast.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A Centipede soldier Raina nurses back after the bridge blast.

verdicts.why: The proposed S1#10 enemy stage is right (Mike names her and threatens her at the bridge exchange), and nothing between them happens in S1#18. The dropped 'turns him into a super soldier' part is kept as a split at S1#11, where fandom says Raina sees to his recovery, without the Hydra name.

value.title: Luke Cage S1#2
value.text: Misty is a friend of Pop's and greets him warmly when her investigation brings her to his barbershop. She is shaken when he is killed in the shooting there.

split.title: Luke Cage S1#5
split.on_a_card_about_b: A friend whose funeral Misty attends.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A detective friend who attends Pop's funeral.

verdicts.why: The barbershop visit and the shooting that kills Pop are both in S1#2 (Code of the Streets); the funeral is S1#5 (Just to Get a Rep), so it is split.

value.title: Luke Cage S1#1
value.text: Rafael Scarfe takes Misty on as his partner when no other detective will work with her, teaching her everything she knows about police work.

split.title: Luke Cage S1#6
split.text: Misty is shattered to learn Scarfe has been on Cottonmouth's payroll, and he dies apologizing to her.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Misty's partner and mentor, secretly on Cottonmouth's payroll, who dies apologizing to her.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Scarfe's partner and protégé. She learns he is dirty as he dies apologizing.

verdicts.why: They are already partners on the Harlem's Paradise case in S1#1; the betrayal and his death are S1#6 (Suckas Need Bodyguards), so they are split.
Their only scene is at Mother's Touch: Tilda says she doesn't know where Bushmaster is, forces Misty out and tells her to get a warrant while he hides in the closet. She never helps Misty.

value.title: Luke Cage S2#1
value.text: Captain Tom Ridenhour is Misty's commanding officer and welcomes her back to the force.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Misty's captain, who welcomes her back to the force.

split.title: Luke Cage S2#7
split.text: Ridenhour tries to talk Misty out of resigning, then is shot dead by Comanche.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Misty's captain, who supports her until Comanche kills him.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A detective whose captain supports her until his death.

verdicts.why: Ridenhour is already Misty's captain at her return in S2#1 (Soul Brother #1); he is killed by Comanche in S2#7, so his death is split.

value.title: Iron Fist S2#5
value.text: Misty and Colleen turn to Ward Meachum when Danny goes missing, and he puts Rand Enterprises security on the search.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Danny's old friend, who helps search for him.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A detective who asks Ward for help finding Danny.

split.title: Iron Fist S2#9
split.text: When Ward bursts in on Misty fighting at Eden Towers and shoots her attacker, she thanks him and he tells her to call him Ward.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Danny's old friend, who saves Misty at Eden Towers.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A detective Ward saves at Eden Towers, and tells to call him Ward.

verdicts.why: Fandom puts the search for Danny in S2#5 and the Eden Towers shooting in S2#9, so the rescue is split.

value.title: WandaVision#4
value.text: Tyler Hayward is Monica Rambeau's superior at S.W.O.R.D. and sends her to investigate the anomaly in Westview.
value.on_b_card_about_a: An agent under Hayward at S.W.O.R.D.

split.title: WandaVision#7
split.text: Monica turns against Hayward once she learns his plans.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Monica's superior at S.W.O.R.D., whom she turns against.
split.on_b_card_about_a: An agent under Hayward at S.W.O.R.D., who turns against him.

verdicts.why: Hayward greets Monica on her return and sends her to Westview in episode 4; she only turns against him after the drone strike and her expulsion in episodes 5-7, so that turn stays at its original episode 7 as a split.

They do team up in S2#3, but that episode ends with Miss Minutes helping Victor Timely set Renslayer adrift in a lifeboat. They only reunite and plot to retake the TVA in S2#4, so S2#4 is where this ally stage holds.
In S2#1 (Ouroboros) Mobius and Loki meet O.B., who greets the forgetful Mobius and reminisces, and they work on the Loom crisis together.
Renslayer has Mobius pruned in S1#4 (The Nexus Event), so the season-long friend stage should only carry the friendship; the pruning goes on its own stage (n 432).

value.title: Loki S1#4
value.text: When Mobius starts questioning the TVA, Renslayer has him pruned to protect the agency.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Mobius's old friend, who has him pruned to protect the TVA.
value.on_b_card_about_a: An old friend Renslayer has pruned.

split.title: Loki S1#6
split.text: Mobius survives the Void and comes back to confront Renslayer, who leaves the TVA to search for free will.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The old friend who had Mobius pruned, whom he confronts on his return.
split.on_b_card_about_a: An old friend who returns from the Void to confront Renslayer.

verdicts.why: The pruning is a real turn in S1#4, but his return and confrontation with her are in S1#6 (For All Time. Always.), so they are split.
Mr. Charles and the Fisks agree to work together on the weapons in S2#1 (The Northern Star); Fisk's betrayal comes in S2#6 (Requiem), on its own stage (n 434).
In S2#6 Fisk lets the AVTF take Mr. Charles's weapons, and Mr. Charles goes to McCaffrey offering to help remove Fisk from office.
Civil War ends with Natasha stunning T'Challa at the airport so Steve and Bucky can escape, which leaves them on opposite sides, not allies.
In Infinity War Natasha comes to Wakanda with Steve to protect Vision and fights beside T'Challa's army in the Battle of Wakanda, a real turn back to allies.
Black Widow ends with Ross and his soldiers surrounding Natasha, and two weeks later she has escaped custody. Ross never drops the manhunt.
At the airport Sam tackles Spider-Man twice, gets webbed, then has Redwing grab Peter and throw him out of the window. No missiles are fired at him.
In episode 2 Nikki finds Wong online and reaches out, and he later portals into the office. Neither wiki nor the episode summaries have her calling him about Blonsky leaving a monitored area.
Stane betrays Raza, paralyzes him and has the Ten Rings cell killed to take the armor, so Iron Man leaves them as enemies.
The 1945 raid in which Peggy, Dugan and Morita capture Werner Reinhardt is shown in Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#1 (Shadows), not in The First Avenger.

Homecoming is set in the fall, not over a summer. Mason runs the computers on the Damage Control truck heist that Spider-Man breaks up, and Peter later busts the Staten Island Ferry deal, so the new text is supported.
In Eyes of Wakanda episode 1 Noni is a disgraced former Dora Milaje sent by Akeya after Nkati. She chooses the Hatut Zeraze only at the end.
Coulson shoots Sinara in the shoulder as she is about to take Quake and Flint in S5#7 (Together or Not at All).
Renslayer and Miss Minutes meet Victor at the 1893 World's Fair, and he and Miss Minutes cast her adrift, all in S2#3 (1893).
The Red Skull guides Thanos to the Soul Stone on Vormir in Avengers: Infinity War.
Reyes is shot in S2#10, but the shooter is unidentified there and blamed on Castle. Schoonover is only revealed as the Blacksmith in S2#12, so putting this stage at S2#10 would spoil the reveal.
Rocket laughs at Taserface's name until the Ravagers mock him too, and the Eclector explodes when Yondu's arrow hits flammable materials.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#4
value.text: Sunil Bakshi, disguised as Glenn Talbot, and Agent 33 move against Phil Coulson's team over a painting carved with alien writing. Coulson chases Bakshi down, knocks him out and takes the painting.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A Hydra agent Coulson knocks out to take the painting.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The director who knocks Bakshi out and takes the painting.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#11
split.text: Coulson hands his prisoner Bakshi over to the real Glenn Talbot.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A Hydra prisoner Coulson hands over to Talbot.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The director who hands Bakshi over to Talbot.

verdicts.why: The Miami painting chase where Coulson I.C.E.R.s Bakshi is S2#4 (Face My Enemy); the handover to Talbot is S2#11 (Aftershocks). Per the split rule it moves to its own stage rather than being dropped.
